body.x: Changwon City (mayor Huh Sung-mu) andChangwon Industry Promotion Agency (Director Baek Jung-han) supported fouroutstanding startups to exhibit in CES 2020 Eureka Park to showcase theirexcellent technologies to the investors and buyers around the world. CES 2020will be held in Las Vegas on Jan. 7 to 10.

At CES 2020, 200,000 people from 4,500companies, investors, buyers, and manufacturers from 161 countries will attend,focusing on artificial intelligence (AI), robots, ultra-high definition TVs,5G, next-gen communication technology, and autonomous driving technology.

Changwon City and Changwon Industry Promotion Agency have been operating Changwon Community Center at CES Eureka Park since 2019 as part of activating Changwon-type technology innovation startup ecosystem. At CES 2019, Edenlux and Safaud participated and prepared a foothold for global expansion in investment and export by consultation with 250 buyers like Google, Facebook and Amazon.
Changwon City's four excellent startups, which were finally selected by CTA, the host of CES 2020, are as follows.
△ Moderntech, the developer of intelligent unmanned charging robot system and battery exchange-type electric scooter charger
△ CTNS, the developer of module design outdoor-type external battery that can change capacity and output layout as needed
△ Good Life, the developer of safety outlets with short-circuit, electric shock, and fire prevention features
△ J2C, the developer of iris recognitiondevice and optical parts with improved operation distance and recognition rate

Changwon City and Changwon IndustryPromotion Agency are doing their best to foster global startups by providingCES 2020 Changwon Joint Pavilion with opportunities for companies to enteroverseas markets, find buyers and attract investment.

Changwon City is planning to visit Silicon Valley, USA, the mecca of technology startups, and interview experts from major universities and startup innovators to prepare a concrete vision for building a Changwon-style technology innovation startup ecosystem. As benchmarking the Silicon Valley startup ecosystem, it will directly promote Changwon startups and also focus on finding investors.

Director Baek said, “We have been participating in CES Eureka Park, the world's best electronics startup exhibition for the second year in a row.” He continued, “We hope that the participating companies can garner great success in CES, and we promise to continue support by developing various program for foster global startups.”
